label: Party
definition: Contextual role played by an entity participating in an identity-related interaction; not a universal superclass of persons organizations devices or software.
scope_note: May be played by heterogeneous kinds supplied by profiles/domain models.

label: IdentitySubject
definition: Contextual role played by an entity that a DigitalIdentity Claim Credential or identity-management process is about.
scope_note: Human/non-human neutral.

label: DigitalIdentity
definition: Managed digital information/representation artifact that represents an IdentitySubject in an IdentityContext.
scope_note: Distinct from subject Account Profile LegalIdentity and Identifier.

label: Identifier
definition: Information/sign used to distinguish or reference an entity or representation under an identifier scheme and scope.
scope_note: DID/SPIFFE ID are profile mappings/specializations.

label: IdentityContext
definition: Contextual situation in which a DigitalIdentity Identifier or identity information receives its intended identity-management interpretation.
scope_note: Not Tenant Realm TrustDomain Audience or social context by default.

label: IdentityAttribute
definition: Information element representing a property/value attributed to an IdentitySubject for identity-management purposes.
scope_note: Do not equate automatically with intrinsic UFO qualities or social identities.

label: Claim
definition: Assertion information object expressing a proposition about an IdentitySubject and optionally one or more IdentityAttributes.
evidence_basis: GateB NC008; OIDC; VC; NIST; academic
scope_note: Protocol name/value claim members are mappings, not ontological definition.

label: Evidence
definition: Information artifact used to support a Claim IdentityProofing IdentityBinding attestation or assessment.
scope_note: Generic evidence; source/derivation explicitly modeled.

label: Proof
definition: Contextual role played by Evidence when it is used to establish or verify a proposition binding or integrity claim.
evidence_basis: GateB NC007; VC Data Integrity; WebAuthn; academic
scope_note: Cryptographic proof mechanisms stay in profiles.

label: IdentityBinding
definition: Relator that mediates an IdentitySubject and one or more identity representations credentials or authenticators and is grounded by evidence/provenance.
scope_note: Distinct from simple aboutness and from account linking.

label: Credential
definition: Issued information artifact carrying/supporting Claims about one or more subjects with provenance and lifecycle/status semantics.
evidence_basis: GateB NC012; NIST; W3C VC; ISO; SPIFFE
scope_note: Includes human/non-human credential categories without equating every token to identity.

label: CredentialStatus
definition: Dependent status mode of a Credential such as active suspended revoked expired or otherwise invalid according to a status scheme.
scope_note: Concrete status-list encodings are profile-specific.

label: CredentialLifecycleEvent
definition: Event that changes or establishes a lifecycle state/status of a Credential.
scope_note: Abstract pattern; profile-specific event types may specialize it.

label: CredentialIssuance
definition: Credential lifecycle event in which an issuer brings an issued Credential into existence or managed validity for a subject/holder context.
scope_note: Issuer role itself is profile-first.

label: IdentityProofing
definition: Event/process that evaluates identity evidence to establish confidence that identity information refers/binds to the intended subject.
scope_note: Not Authentication.

label: Enrollment
definition: Event/process establishing a managed identity relationship or representation for an IdentitySubject within an identity-management context.
scope_note: Not Provisioning.

label: Authentication
definition: Event/process that verifies an entity/claimant or control of an Authenticator under an authentication context and produces an AuthenticationResult.
scope_note: Distinct from proofing federation and authorization.

label: Authenticator
definition: Contextual role played by a heterogeneous entity/artifact used by an actor during Authentication to demonstrate control/presence/knowledge or other authentication capability.
scope_note: Device/key/secret are not forced into one kind.

label: AuthenticationResult
definition: Information/result artifact recording the outcome of an Authentication including success/failure and references to assurance/context as needed.
scope_note: Distinct from Session.

label: AssuranceAssessment
definition: Assessment artifact stating an assurance dimension target and level/value/confidence with provenance/evidence.
scope_note: Dimensions include proofing authentication federation attribute etc.; no single overloaded LoA.

label: Authorization
definition: Event/process evaluating an AuthorizationRequest and producing an AuthorizationResult/decision.
scope_note: Minimal authorization semantics only.

label: AuthorizationRequest
definition: Information object describing a requested Principal-Action-Resource access operation and associated AuthorizationContext.
scope_note: Separate from evaluation event and result.

label: AuthorizationContext
definition: Situation/environmental context relevant to authorization evaluation such as time device network or request conditions.
scope_note: Distinct from IdentityContext.

label: AuthorizationResult
definition: Decision/result artifact produced by Authorization recording an explicit authorization decision and references to request/context.
scope_note: Refines baseline AuthorizationResult rather than adding duplicate Decision class.

label: Principal
definition: Contextual role played by an entity or managed representation to which permissions/grants apply or that participates as authorization subject/actor.
evidence_basis: GateB NC024; AWS; Entra; Google; Kubernetes
scope_note: Principal is not Person and not synonymous with IdentitySubject.

label: Resource
definition: Contextual role played by an entity/information/service that is the protected target of an authorization request or permission.
scope_note: Digital/non-digital target kinds remain external.

label: Action
definition: Description/specification of an action type or intended operation evaluated in authorization; not the executed event instance itself.
scope_note: Profile mappings may use protocol action strings.

label: Permission
definition: Normative information object describing an allowed Action over a Resource or resource scope under defined semantics.
scope_note: IAM roles/permission sets map to PermissionBundle in P01, not UFO roles.

label: AccessGrant
definition: Relator/assignment that mediates a Principal with one or more Permissions and optional Resource/scope/validity, independently of runtime authorization decisions.
scope_note: Durable grant ≠ AuthorizationResult.

label: Delegation
definition: Relator by which an authorizing party/principal empowers another actor/principal to exercise specified permissions or actions within a scope.
evidence_basis: GateB NC027; RFC8693; agent evidence; academic
scope_note: Supports actsOnBehalfOf without conflating actor and subject.

label: TrustAssessment
definition: Assessment artifact concerning trust in a party claim credential source or interaction, explicitly separated from governance framework status and cryptographic validation.
evidence_basis: GateB NC029; ONTrust alignment; academic; government
scope_note: Can align to external ONTrust:Trust semantics rather than redefine them.

label: TrustReference
definition: Reference/alignment artifact that identifies an external trust concept framework source or alignment target relevant to CM4DI semantics.
scope_note: No longer a catch-all for TrustFramework Registry Anchor or certification.

label: RelyingParty
definition: Contextual role played by an organization software/service or other party that relies on identity authentication or credential information in an interaction.
scope_note: Anti-rigid; not a rigid actor kind.

label: Verifier
definition: Generic contextual role played by an entity that verifies evidence authentication material or credential presentations; concrete role semantics must be specialized by context/profile.
scope_note: AuthenticationVerifier and CredentialPresentationVerifier must not be conflated.
